Claims_Documents has composite PK (Claim_ID, Document_Type_Code) -> composite-PK member max_l0=30 path exercised
Claims_Documents.Claim_ID is both PK member and FK to Claim_Headers.Claim_Header_ID (child PK is FK)

Claims_Processing.Claim_Stage_ID has no declared FK to Claims_Processing_Stages (dangling by name only)

Claims_Processing_Stages only 2 rows; level-0 size 1+30*u may exceed parent pool for FK draws
operator_ts_expectations: Date fuzzer on DATETIME: template from first parsable element = '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' (space, seconds); fresh dates uniform 1800-2100 unless p returns element
Number fuzzer on INTEGER PKs: fresh uniform in [-10^4,10^4] then +-1/+-2 perturbation -> IDs far outside observed 15-986 range
String fuzzer on CHAR(15) codes: fresh random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length<=15, plus contaminate suffix/prefix -> implausible codes like 'Deputy' replaced by 'xK3(p'
String fuzzer on VARCHAR(255) names: random strings, not name-like -> FN when gold filters on name patterns
Number fuzzer on DECIMAL(20,4): scale=4 gives range +-10000, observed 100-800 -> implausible amounts, FN on amount thresholds
FK draws from parent final values with replacement -> duplicate Customer_ID in Policies (observed distinct=10 of 15) preserved; ties present
Composite PK Claims_Documents: sample_fresh_primary_keys drops dup (Claim_ID,Document_Type_Code) pairs; max_l0=30 caps fresh draws
Claims_Processing_Stages 2 rows but level-0 size 1+30*u -> FK from Claims_Processing.Claim_Stage_ID may draw NULLs if parent empty after filtering
Date_of_Settlement vs Date_of_Claim ordering (settlement>=claim) NOT enforced by TS -> FP on queries comparing them
Amount_Piad vs Amount_Claimed (paid<=claimed) NOT enforced -> FP on such comparisons

Claim_Status_Code in {Settled,Disputed,In Progress} vs Claim_Outcome_Code in {In progress,Disputed,Settled} - case differs ('In Progress' vs 'In progress'); TS String fuzzer ignores this -> FN on equality joins
Next_Claim_Stage_ID all '1' (distinct=1): Number fuzzer will scatter -> FN on stage-chain queries
